title: Dave-level unlock chapters
kicker: Session and shell · level up and power
hook: **Vision:** complexity will drip by **Dave’s level** so day one is not a spreadsheet — this is not what gates the live rail today.

blindSpots.meaning: Locked design, not playable as a gate yet. You cannot turn this on in the current build.
Your summoner’s endless level — see [Dave’s level](dave-level). Chapters would open features as that number rises.
A drip of systems (items, pacts, map…) timed to a Dave threshold — not a story cutscene book.
What you have now unlocks on [play beats](unlock-beats), not on this table.

alsoTrue: Thresholds will live in balance data later. Exact numbers below are the product map, not a promise that the live game already enforces them.
Dave’s level has no cap. New worlds raise prestige; they do not wipe who you are.

sections.title: Not in the current loop
paras: Open the rail today and you will see beat unlocks, not Dave-gated chapters.
Read this page to understand the intended drip — then play with [unlock beats](unlock-beats) until chapters ship.

sections.title: Chapter map (Vision)
sections.intro: What the product wants to open as Dave grows:

rows: Lawn, Sanctum, Creatures, deploy, souls; altar when you have souls
World-stage empire; farm and defend verbs

sections.title: Why chapters exist (as design)
paras: A full rail on minute one turns the hall into a spreadsheet.
Chapters keep lawn-first onboarding while still promising the whole war over time.

doTitle: What you do with this page
doSteps: Treat the table as future design, not a checklist for today’s build.
Use [unlock beats](unlock-beats) for what the rail actually does now.
When you wonder “why isn’t X open at Dave 10?”, remember chapters are Vision.
doNote: Stop when you can separate Vision chapters from live beats. Related power: [Dave’s level](dave-level).

mixUps.q: I reached Dave 20 — where are Expeditions?
mixUps.a: Expeditions unlock on the live beat (bound demon), not on this Vision table yet.
They are the product map. Balance data will own the live thresholds later.

mixUps.q: Does a new world reset Dave?
mixUps.a: New worlds are prestige of place — you keep who you are. See [New world](new-world-prestige).

mixUps.q: Is this the same as unlock beats?
mixUps.a: No. Beats are Shipped. Chapters are Vision.
